method.estimator: task mean (each task's mean pass over its scored attempts, then the mean over tasks); task-clustered percentile bootstrap intervals; pairs from runner/stats/paired.ts clusteredPairedDelta over per-task means of the attempts scored in both cells, Holm within model across primary pairs for the two-sided sign-flip p and for the one-sided non-inferiority p
method.wall_time: median over scored trials, contended (trials of a shard may overlap)
method.cost: recorded USD of every trial record of the cell (excluded ones included; a run a rerun replaced is not a record) over scored passes; metered dollars only: the dollars the proxy charged at a full reservation because a request carried no usage (usage.usd_reserved) are left out of usd_total, cost per solve and its interval, and reported as usd_reserved

verdict_rules.home: the model's home harness; every other cell of the model is compared with it
verdict_rules.incomplete: the cell or its home cell has a planned trial with no record, or the pair has fewer than min_paired_tasks (10 by default) tasks with an attempt scored in both cells: reported from what exists, no claim
verdict_rules.descriptive: an extension cell (descriptive in the spec, for example one attempt per task): estimate and intervals only, no test and no non-inferiority claim
verdict_rules.behind: a primary pair whose two-sided task-level sign-flip p, Holm-adjusted across the model's primary pairs, is at or below alpha with the cell below its home
verdict_rules.no-room: can't tell: no room to improve: a primary pair that is not behind and would be within-15, but fewer than min_paired_tasks of its paired tasks are ones the run can tell apart (a task every main cell passed on every attempt, or every main cell failed on every attempt, can't), or on those tasks the home cell's passes leave the cell less than 15 points to fall
verdict_rules.within-15: a primary pair that is not behind and whose one-sided non-inferiority p at a 15-point margin (the share of task-bootstrap draws of cell minus home at or below -15 points), Holm-adjusted across the model's primary pairs, is at or below alpha
verdict_rules.saturated: a primary pair that is neither behind nor within-15 and whose home cell averages at least saturated_at (95% by default) on the paired tasks, or where no paired task differs: a ceiling, not a tie
verdict_rules.inconclusive: every other primary pair: the data show neither that the cell is within 15 points of its home nor that it is behind
